decisions.reason: A reference class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's decades of dosimetry and accredited calibration expertise, so it is easy to absorb and improve, and it is featured as a flagship on the home page.

Oncology risk management software is further from the firm's measurement-based knowledge, which makes its early results harder to interpret, but it fits the software integration and patient safety direction and is still presented on its own page.
A CT image quality phantom builds directly on the firm's phantom and imaging QA know-how and is newly launched within the flagship imaging QA push.
A mammography image quality phantom draws on related imaging QA knowledge and supports the new imaging line, although it overlaps somewhat with the full field phantom.
The full field mammography phantom complements the imaging QA portfolio and is recent enough that management will keep learning from its results before any consolidation with Product D.
This flagship imaging QA instrument line extends the firm's measurement and integration capabilities into a strategic growth area and was only just launched.
